    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=min(set(x for row in grid for x in row)-{max(set(x for row in grid for x in row))}) if False else None

    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row); background=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    outline=next(c for c in cnt if c!=background)
    seen=set(); q=deque()
